ticket_text: I can't log in to my Northbeam account after resetting my password — the 2FA app keeps saying 'device not recognized' even though I just reinstalled it. I've tried on multiple devices and browsers, and I'm completely locked out. I need to access my workspace to review client reports and respond to emails. I also need a copy of all my data from the past 12 months for compliance purposes.

I forgot my password and reset it using the password recovery link, but I still can't access my account. I've tried logging in with the new password and my 2FA device, but the system keeps showing 'authentication failed'. I'm unable to retrieve any financial reports or update our billing information.

Hi, I'm reaching out from the finance team to request access to the export logs for the last quarter. We're reviewing our budget allocations and need to verify the data used in our monthly reports. The reports show some inconsistencies, and we'd like to cross-check against the actual export history. Could you please provide a copy of all export logs from January to March? We're not experiencing any service issues or login problems, and the app is fully functional. We understand there's a 30-day statutory period for such requests, and we're not asking for immediate action — just the data to support our internal audit.

Our entire finance team is unable to access the Northbeam dashboard — all users are seeing a blank screen and the login page times out. We need to know why this is happening, and we’re unable to view any financial reports or export data. This has already caused a cascade of delays in our monthly close, and we’re now missing key client billing information. We’ve tried resetting passwords and clearing cache, but nothing works. We also need all data from the last 12 months related to financial transactions, revenue tracking, and expense reports for audit purposes. We believe this is a full-service outage affecting every user, not just one person.

Our payment gateway failed at 3:15 PM today, and the workspace just went into suspended status. We can't process any invoices, which means we’re losing client contracts and will miss several key deadlines. The charge from last month was $1,200, and we’ve now been charged again for the same period — a duplicate charge. We’ve contacted our payment provider, but they say it’s a system error on their end. We need immediate help to reverse the charge and verify if it’s a billing error or a platform issue. Without resolution, we’ll be unable to serve our clients, and we’re at risk of losing major accounts. This is urgent because our next client signing deadline is in 4 hours and we can’t send proposals without a valid invoice. Can you confirm if this is a billing error and if we can get a refund and reactivation of the workspace immediately?

We’ve been using Northbeam for the past year and have found several workflows that could be improved. Specifically, there's no way to generate a custom report that filters by both project phase and team member. This limits our ability to track cross-team deliverables. We’ve tried the built-in reports, but none offer the combination of filters we need. A new report type that allows filtering by both project phase and assigned user would greatly improve our planning and accountability. We understand this is a feature request, but we’re currently in a tight deadline to finalize our Q2 budget, so a solution would be helpful in the short term. We're also considering third-party tools for this, but would rather use Northbeam if possible.

We need to verify the billing records for the Q2 2024 subscription period. Specifically, we're seeing a discrepancy in the invoice totals between the portal and our finance system. We've cross-checked the seat count and plan details, but the charges don't align. Could you provide a detailed export of all transactions for that period, including line items and timestamps, to help us audit and resolve this? We also want to confirm if any partial charges or prorated fees were applied.

We need a new feature to allow exporting reports directly to PDF with customizable formatting — like font size, margins, and header/footer. Right now, we have to manually copy and paste from the report view, which takes hours every week. This is especially problematic for our clients who need formal, branded documentation. We’re in the middle of a quarterly audit and have a deadline next Tuesday for submitting reports to our compliance team. Without this feature, we’re at risk of missing the audit window. The current export only gives CSV, which isn’t acceptable for legal or financial documentation. We’ve tried reaching out to support before, but no one has acknowledged the need. This isn’t a bug — it’s a critical gap in functionality that prevents us from working efficiently and meeting compliance timelines. Please add this to your backlog and prioritize it for release in the next sprint. We’re not asking for a workaround — we need this feature to be available in the next version.

Our finance team is blocked from running month-end closing reports because the automated export from the revenue module is failing for all users. The reports show a blank CSV every time, and the error logs indicate a sync failure between the financial module and the ledger system. This has been happening for the past two days and we’re now past the deadline to file our Q2 financial statements. We’ve tried restarting the service, clearing browser caches, and checking the sync status in the admin panel, but nothing resolves it. Without this data, we cannot close the books or provide accurate financials to stakeholders, and the client audit is due in 48 hours. This is impacting every finance team member, and the lack of visibility into revenue and expenses is causing significant delays across the business.

Our team is unable to access the Northbeam dashboard. All users are seeing a blank screen when trying to log in, and the login page fails to load. This has been happening across all devices and browsers for over 45 minutes. We're not able to check any reports or manage projects, and we have no workaround. The service is completely down for the entire organization.

We’ve been asking for a way to schedule recurring tasks in the project management dashboard for months now. Our team has had to manually create tasks every week for team check-ins, which takes up valuable time. Last quarter, during the sprint planning phase, we noticed that two teams were accidentally overlapping their task schedules, causing confusion and missed deadlines. We even reached out to support in June after a similar issue disrupted our quarterly review, but no solution was provided. There’s a clear gap in functionality that’s been consistently requested across our department. Could we please have a feature that allows users to set up recurring tasks with custom intervals and reminders? This would save hours every week and prevent scheduling errors. We’re especially concerned about how this feature would help prevent the kind of overlap we saw last quarter. We’re not asking for anything urgent—just something that’s been missing and has been requested repeatedly.

I was unable to log in to my Northbeam account last night after resetting my password on my phone. I followed the recovery steps, but the 2FA app still won't verify. I also received a notification that my previous login attempt was from a new device, which I didn’t authorize. This is the second time this has happened in the past month — last April, a similar issue occurred and it took three days to resolve. I’m concerned that this could be a pattern or a security concern, especially since I have a finance team that relies on access to reports daily.

I've been locked out of my account for the third time this week, and after resetting my password on both my phone and laptop, I still can't log in. I just got a notification saying my 2FA device is missing, and I'm not sure what happened — I never lost it. Last month, there was a similar issue where my account went down for 4 hours, and I had to wait for a full reset. I remember when that happened, it took 24 hours to get access back, and the support team said it was a 'temporary glitch'. Now I'm worried it's the same thing — my team is relying on me to manage invoices and client communications, and I can't even log in to check my dashboard. I’ve tried the recovery email, but it’s not working. I can’t believe this is happening again after the previous incident. I don’t want to wait another day — I need access to my account immediately to fix the billing and client updates that are piling up.

The report dashboard in the Northbeam app has been showing incorrect dates for the last two days. We've confirmed this isn't a system-wide issue, as the calendar view and team lists are functioning correctly. The data appears to be pulled from the correct sources, but the date alignment is off by one day consistently. We need to verify if this is a known bug or a configuration issue. Can you provide access to the last 30 days of export data so we can audit the timestamps and validate the discrepancy?

I need to export all of my team's project data from the past six months for compliance auditing. Specifically, I require the full history of completed tasks, timeline logs, and user activity for each project. This data will be used to verify access patterns and ensure alignment with our internal data retention policy. Please confirm what types of data are available and provide a list of the fields included in the export. I also need to know if there are any restrictions based on user roles or project access levels.

We've been experiencing intermittent sync errors between our Northbeam dashboard and our Google Calendar integration for the past two weeks. Last month, during a financial reporting deadline, the sync failed for three days, causing a delay in client meetings. Since then, the issue has sporadically reappeared, sometimes only affecting specific users in the team. The sync logs show consistent timeouts, and when it fails, the calendar events appear in the wrong time zone. We’ve tried restarting the integration and clearing the cache, but the problem persists. This is impacting our team’s ability to schedule and track work, especially with recurring meetings. We noticed a similar issue in Q2 last year, when the same integration failed across multiple teams during a quarterly audit. That incident was resolved after a patch, but the recurrence suggests a deeper underlying issue. We’re concerned this may be a regression or a configuration drift in the integration logic.

We've been having issues with login access for the past three weeks. Last month, two team members were locked out after multiple failed attempts and had to use the recovery email, which we've already used twice before. This time, I tried to reset my password and the 2FA app stopped responding — even after restarting the device. I’ve seen this before with the 2FA app crashing, and it happened during a prior outage when the system was down for over 4 hours. Now, with the app still not recognizing my device, I can’t access our projects or approve invoices. We’ve tried resetting the app, rebooting, and even contacting support last time, but the same problem came back. The team is blocked from working, and without access, we’re unable to meet deadlines or respond to clients. This is not a one-off — it’s a recurring pattern that’s been going on for months, and we’re at risk of losing key clients because of it. I really need help getting back in so we can continue operations.

We’ve been having issues with recurring charges on our plan since last quarter, especially with the monthly subscription hitting the same amount even after adjusting seat counts. This is the second time this has happened — during Q2 we were double-charged for May and had to manually dispute it. We’re now seeing the same pattern again, and it’s affecting our cash flow. We need clarification on whether the billing system is syncing seat changes correctly, and if there’s a way to resolve the overage. Our team has also noticed that the invoice details show the same number of seats as before, despite our recent downgrade. We’re not experiencing any service outages or login issues, and the product functions normally.

I'm reaching out to request a data export of all financial activity related to our workspace from January 1st to April 30th, including transaction details, user access logs, and invoice records. This is needed for our quarterly audit with the external accounting firm, and they require the data by the end of this week. We’re already in contact with the firm and have been advised that missing or delayed data could impact our compliance reporting. I’ve reviewed the documentation on data export options but couldn’t find a clear way to filter by date range or include access logs in the export. Can you please assist with generating this export and confirming that it contains all required fields? We’ve been using the platform for over two years and need to ensure that all data is complete and traceable for regulatory purposes.

We can't generate financial reports from the last two weeks — the report engine just hangs and shows a blank screen. This has been happening since Monday morning, and our CFO just called to confirm we can't close the month-end. The export to CSV also fails, and the dashboard shows no data even though the underlying data is present. We need this fixed immediately because the audit committee is due to review our financials by end of day. We’ve tried restarting the service and clearing the cache, but nothing works. It’s not just one report — all report types are affected. We’re losing credibility with stakeholders and the team is scrambling to work manually, which is error-prone and time-consuming. If this isn’t resolved by 3 PM, we’ll have to inform the board that we’re unable to provide timely financial statements.

We need to export all financial data from the last six months for our audit, and we’re also requesting a new feature — a detailed breakdown of spending by project — so we can better track budgets. The current reports don’t show project-level costs, and we’re currently missing key financial insights. This is urgent because our external auditor is asking for this data by Friday, and we can’t proceed without it. We’ve tried the export function, but it only gives us a flat list of transactions. We also believe the product should have a built-in project-based budget tracker to improve financial visibility across our team.

I've been trying to use the export feature for the last two days, and every time I click it, the file downloads as a blank CSV. I've checked multiple reports and the data isn't missing — it's just not appearing. I can see the data in the dashboard, but when I try to export it, nothing shows up. This is breaking our payroll process, and we're now having to manually re-enter everything. I also need to export all of my historical data from the past 18 months for compliance reasons, but I don't know how to request it properly. Can you please help me get access to the full data history and fix the export functionality? It's been happening across all our teams, so it's not just me or one user. The app is fully loading and working fine otherwise, just this export function is broken.

We’ve been getting duplicate charges for our monthly subscription every month now — it started last March and has continued through May. Our accountant just confirmed it’s not a manual error, and the invoices show two separate charges for the same period. This has caused significant financial disruption, and we’re now preparing to file a formal dispute with our bank. The workspace is still active, but we can’t invoice clients without knowing if we’re being charged twice. We need this resolved urgently before the end of June, because we’re about to close a major client contract and can’t risk appearing untrustworthy or inaccurate in our billing records. We’ve also noticed that the subscription status in the dashboard shows 'active' even though we’ve been charged twice. Can you please verify if this is a system duplication issue and confirm if it’s a billing error or a pricing configuration bug? We’re ready to escalate to our finance team if no action is taken within 24 hours.

Our finance team just discovered that the last invoice for March was charged twice, and the second charge has not been refunded. This has created a serious compliance risk because we’re now in violation of our internal policy on duplicate billing. The workspace is still active, but we’re unable to process any further invoices until this is resolved. We’ve already notified our auditors, and they’ve requested a full explanation by end of day today. We also need to verify if this was a one-time error or if it’s part of a broader issue with the billing engine. We’re not sure if the charges are reflected in our accounting software or if they’re still pending, and we can’t proceed with client billing without a clear resolution. This is not just a billing dispute — it’s a time-sensitive issue that could lead to penalties and reputational damage if not addressed immediately. We’ve tried to contact support before, but no one has responded to our previous message in over 48 hours.

Our finance team has been unable to generate accurate month-end reports for the past three days. The report templates are loading slowly and showing inconsistent data—some entries are missing, others are duplicated. We’ve tried refreshing the page and clearing cache, but the issue persists. This is blocking our audit readiness and preventing us from submitting financial statements to stakeholders. We also need access to all transaction logs from January to April for reconciliation purposes. If we can’t get this fixed quickly, we may have to delay our Q2 close, which could impact our client retention and board reviews. We’re really concerned about the accuracy of our numbers right now.

I need to export all the data related to our marketing campaign from Q1 2024. Specifically, I'd like access to user activity logs, campaign performance reports, and team member access history. This is for internal audit purposes and will be securely stored. I understand there may be a delay in processing, but I need the data within the next 30 days as per applicable privacy regulations.

I'm unable to log in to the Northbeam account because I lost my 2FA device and can't reset it through the app. I've tried the recovery email and phone options, but none of them work. I'm the only one affected, and I need access to view the project timelines to prepare for next week's client meeting.

This is really frustrating after what happened last quarter — we were charged twice for the same subscription, and even after contacting support, the issue wasn't resolved. Now, I'm getting another failed charge attempt today, and our team is stuck trying to invoice clients without access to the reporting tools. I’ve seen the same failure in the last three billing cycles, and each time, the support team said it would be fixed but never did. I’m not just asking for a refund — I need a clear explanation of why this is happening and what steps are being taken to prevent it. I can’t trust the billing system anymore, especially after the previous double-charge. I’ve been locked out of the account for 12 hours due to a failed payment, and I’ve already tried to reset my credentials, which only made things worse.

Our compliance team needs to verify data access logs from the past six months for all team members. We're conducting an internal audit and need a full export of all access events, including timestamps, user IDs, and data types accessed. This is required by our GDPR review schedule, and we need it by end of day. The data must include any access to financial reports, project timelines, and client contact information. We're not asking for a feature or a fix — we need the raw audit trail to prove data handling compliance. If this cannot be provided in the next 4 hours, we may need to escalate to legal. Please confirm availability and provide steps to access this data immediately.

I'm unable to access my Northbeam account after resetting my password. I followed the steps to reset it via email, but when I try to log in, I'm still prompted for 2FA and the device I used to reset it is no longer available. I'm not sure if it's a temporary issue or if the reset process failed. I also need to know what data is stored about my company in the system, especially since we're preparing for a compliance audit.

We're seeing a massive drop in our monthly report accuracy — the revenue summary is now showing zero sales for all products, even though the underlying data is correct. This started happening two days ago after a system update. The team can't trust the reports to invoice clients, and we're now at risk of missing critical deadlines. We also need a full export of the last 30 days of financial data to verify the reports and confirm where the error originated.

I can't access my account after changing my email address last week. I reset my password and got a new 2FA device, but when I try to log in, it says 'Invalid credentials' even though I'm using the correct password and the new device. I've tried on two different browsers and devices, and it's still not working. I need to recover access to my account because I'm the finance manager and I can't verify invoices or approve payments without it. Can you help me get back in? I also need to request a copy of all financial transactions from the last 12 months for compliance purposes.

I need to export all the data from my last quarter's reports so I can prepare for the audit. The app says I can only export in CSV, and I'm not getting any data back — it's just blank files. I'm worried this might violate compliance standards, so I need full access to everything stored in the system. Can you please help me get a complete data export of all reports, user activity logs, and project timelines from Q1 2024? I’ve already tried the export button, but it fails with error 403. I’m not sure if this is a technical bug or if I need a special access level to see this data. I’d also like to know what data is being stored per user and how long it’s kept before deletion. Can you confirm that and provide access to the full dataset?

We've been experiencing total app downtime across all teams for the past two hours. Our entire sales and operations staff is unable to access the dashboard, and the login page is completely blank. This is happening on all devices, including mobile and desktop. This is similar to the incident last Thursday when the service went down for over four hours, and we were unable to track client progress during that time. We’ve also noticed that the API is returning 503 errors consistently across all endpoints. We’re not sure if this is a new issue or a recurrence of a known service instability. Since everyone is affected and no workarounds are available, we’re concerned this could impact our reporting deadlines and client commitments. We need immediate confirmation of the status and a timeline for resolution.

I need to export all of the financial data from the last six months for a compliance audit. Specifically, I would like access to transaction logs, invoice details, and user activity for the finance team during that period. Can you confirm what data is stored and provide a downloadable copy of this information?

We're having a major problem with our financial reporting dashboard — it's been showing incorrect figures for the last three days. The revenue numbers are off by over 20%, and the month-end close is now impossible. We've tried refreshing, restarting the sync, and even clearing the cache, but nothing works. The data seems to sync in correctly from the source systems, but the dashboard displays wrong values. This is affecting our CFO's quarterly review and we can't present accurate financials to stakeholders. We need a quick fix, and also, could you please provide a full export of the last 90 days of financial data so we can audit the source of the error? We're very frustrated and the team is scrambling to fix this on their own. This has been going on for over a week and it's severely impacting our operations.

I need access to all my account data, including logs of user activity and export history, so I can audit compliance with our internal policies. I've tried the data export button, but it only shows a few entries and I can't find the full audit trail. Is there a way to get a complete, downloadable log of everything stored in my account? This is urgent because our legal team needs this for a compliance review by Friday.

I need all of my data deleted immediately — I just found out that a third-party vendor accessed my account through a misconfigured API key, and I'm worried about a data breach. I’ve been working on sensitive client information, and I can’t afford any further exposure. Please export all data from my workspace and permanently delete it from your system. I need this done within the next 24 hours because I’ve already notified my legal team and they’re demanding a full audit and data removal. I’m also asking for a certification that all data has been securely wiped.

We need all customer data from our workspace deleted immediately — specifically, all records from January to April 2024. This is a GDPR compliance requirement after a third-party audit flagged potential data exposure. The data includes user activity logs, project timelines, and billing history. We have a 72-hour deadline to ensure we meet the regulatory requirements. If you can't provide a full deletion of all data, we will have to engage a legal team and escalate this to our compliance officer.

Hi, I'm having trouble with the latest invoice for our March plan. We received a charge for $1,200, but we only have 10 users and our plan is capped at $800. The invoice shows an incorrect seat count, and we're not sure if this is a billing error or a duplicate charge. We need to dispute this before the end of the month, as it could affect our budget and client communications. Can you please verify the seat count and assist with a refund or correction?

We're conducting a financial audit and need all the data from the past six months — specifically, all transaction logs, user activity for finance team members, and billing records. We’ve already tried to export it through the interface, but the export fails and says 'insufficient permissions'. I’ve also checked the data access logs and can’t find any records of when the data was last accessed. We need this information to verify compliance with our internal policies and to resolve discrepancies in our financial reports. Is there a way to get this data directly from your system or through a secure download? We’re not asking for a new feature — we just need access to historical data we already have stored. This isn’t urgent in the sense of a service outage or blocked login, but it’s critical for our audit timeline.

We've been experiencing issues with the Northbeam dashboard across all teams for the past two days. Every user is seeing blank pages when logging in, and the API returns 503 errors consistently. This mirrors the incident in April when the service went down during payroll processing, and it’s causing significant delays in our financial reporting. We’ve confirmed that no individual user is affected, and all team members are unable to access any data or metrics. The finance department relies on real-time insights, and without access, we’re unable to finalize month-end closures. We’re concerned this might be a systemic service failure, not isolated to one user or feature.

Hi, I'm having trouble with the recent invoice from March 31st. It shows a charge of $120 for a plan that was only active for 10 days, and I didn't authorize that billing. I've checked our payment history and can't find any record of this charge. I'm not sure if this is a duplicate or a mistake, but I need to verify it before I can request a refund. I'm reaching out now because the invoice was sent to my manager and they're preparing a financial report that includes this line item, and I'm concerned it might impact our budget. Could you please look into this and confirm whether the charge was valid or if there's an error in the billing system?

Our finance team can't access the Northbeam dashboard right now — every login attempt times out and we're seeing a 503 error on all screens. We're in the middle of the month-end close and need to finalize client reports and send them to stakeholders by 5 PM. Without access, we can't generate the monthly P&L or verify the revenue figures, and the audit team is already calling. This is affecting every single person in the finance department, not just one user. We've tried clearing cache and rebooting, but nothing works. The service is completely down and we're truly stuck.

I'm requesting a data export of all activity logs from January to June 2024, specifically for the customer support team. This is needed to audit access patterns following a recent internal review. We previously had a similar request in Q1 that took 14 days to process, and the data was incomplete. I'd like to ensure this one is prioritized and delivered in full with proper timestamps and user agent details.

I need to export all data associated with my company's Northbeam account for compliance purposes. This includes user activity logs, project timelines, and integration metadata. I've already attempted to access this through the dashboard, but there's no export option available under the 'Data' section. Can you please provide a full data export or confirm the availability of such a feature in the current version?

Our team has been trying to audit user access logs for the past 48 hours, but we can't find any historical data from January through March. We need all access logs for every user during that period, including who accessed what and when. This is critical for compliance with our internal data governance policy and we’re being audited by our legal team. We’ve already checked the dashboard and can’t see any export option for this timeframe. Can you please provide a complete export of all access events from January 1 to March 31, 2024? We also want to verify what data is stored per user and whether any sensitive information was accessed by third parties. We need this data urgently to meet our compliance requirements.

Our team has noticed a discrepancy in the March invoicing cycle. The system shows a charge of $1,200 for a workspace that was only upgraded to the Pro plan on March 1st, and we have not billed clients for the full month. We need to verify the charges and confirm whether this was a mistake in the seat allocation or a failed API sync. We also need access to the billing activity log for the past 90 days to investigate further. Please provide a detailed breakdown of the charges and confirm if any seats were incorrectly billed.

Our entire finance team is locked out of the Northbeam platform right now. The login page is completely blank and no one can access any data or reports. This is happening across all devices and browsers. We need to resolve this immediately because we have a client meeting in 45 minutes and we cannot present our financial statements. Without access to dashboards and transaction logs, we risk losing trust with our clients and missing critical deadlines. This is not just a single-user issue — every person on the finance team is affected. We've tried resetting passwords and clearing caches, but nothing works. We're in real-time risk of violating contractual reporting obligations due to this unavailability.

Our team of 12 users is unable to access the Northbeam platform. The login page is returning a 503 error for everyone, and no user can log in from any device. We've verified that the issue is not isolated to a single user or device. All team members are affected simultaneously, and the service is completely down across all browsers and networks.

The invoice for our March subscription has been issued twice, and we're now being charged $1,200 for a plan we've already paid for. Our finance team is reviewing the records and needs confirmation that this is a duplicate charge. We're concerned about the accuracy of billing and whether we can dispute this with our bank. We also want to know if there's a way to adjust our seat count going forward to reflect our actual team size.

I can't log in to my Northbeam account from any device. I've tried resetting my password three times, but each time I'm redirected to a blank screen. The login page just loads and then disappears. My team is completely locked out, and we can't access our dashboards or any of our project data. This has been happening for over 12 hours now, and we've tried both our primary and secondary devices, including a new phone. No one on the team can access the app at all. I'm worried this could be a security issue since the login page is not loading and we're seeing error messages about 'invalid session' even after clearing cache. We urgently need to know what data we have stored and whether any of it was accessed improperly. Can you please help us regain access and provide a full data export of everything stored under our company account? I've also noticed that our billing dashboard is not loading, but I suspect that's a secondary issue caused by the main login failure.

We need a way to export team-wide project summaries as a PDF report automatically at the end of each week. Right now, we can only export individual task lists, and that takes hours to compile manually. With our clients relying on weekly updates, we’re falling behind. The reports are critical for client trust and compliance, and we’ve already missed two client meetings because of the delay. This isn’t a bug — it’s a feature we absolutely need. We’ve tried asking via support before, but no one has responded with a roadmap or timeline. Can you please add a 'Weekly Project Summary' export option in the admin dashboard? It would be a massive help and a game-changer for our operations.

We're having a major problem with our financial reports in Northbeam. The revenue summary dashboard has been showing incorrect figures for three days now — it's showing $200K in revenue when actuals are only $80K. We checked the data in the raw export and it's accurate, so we believe the dashboard is miscalculating. This is critical because we need to present accurate numbers to our CFO and board meeting tomorrow. We're not able to trust any of the other reports either. We also need a copy of all financial data from the last quarter for audit purposes, and we're not sure where to find it in the system.

We've been asking for a dedicated finance dashboard for months now. Every time we try to track expenses or reconcile accounts, we have to manually pull data from multiple tabs and spreadsheets. Last quarter, we had a critical issue where the revenue summary was missing entirely — it took three days to trace and fix. This time, the same pattern is happening: no visibility into monthly P&L, and we're forced to rely on workarounds that are both time-consuming and error-prone. We need a consolidated view that shows key financial KPIs: revenue, expenses, burn rate, and cash flow. The current product just doesn't support what we need. We’ve already shared this request with support in October, and it wasn’t addressed. This is not a bug — it’s a fundamental gap in the product for finance teams like ours.

We need to verify the charges applied to our company's account in March and April. The invoice from April 1st shows a charge for 10 additional seats that were not approved. We believe this may be a billing error due to a misconfiguration during a recent plan upgrade. Could you please provide a detailed breakdown of the charges from March 1st to April 30th, including the line items and corresponding service usage? We also request access to the audit logs for those months to confirm who made the change and when.

I'm having trouble accessing my Northbeam account after trying to reset my password last week. I followed the steps, but I'm still locked out and can't log in.
